Overview.Name: Minikuri Reethu Reddy
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 2: Poha (rice poha) (1 medium bowl ~1.5 cups cooked) & curd (small cup)
Option 3: Curd rice (small bowl cooked rice & curd & salt)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (slightly higher portion) & chicken curry (pressure-cooked) & curd (small cup)
Option 2: Cooked rice (slightly higher portion) & fish curry (simple) & curd (small cup)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (pan-cooked) & curd (small cup)
Meal_3: Option 1: Egg curry (2 eggs) & small bowl cooked rice

Notes_and_Tips: Goal is healthy weight gain to 52 kg: increase portions slightly and prioritise protein (eggs/chicken/fish/paneer) daily.
PCOS support: avoid sugary snacks and keep rice portion steady (don’t spike & crash).
Social gatherings: eat your planned meal first, then choose one small item only.
Irregular routine: keep 3 fixed meal slots, even if timing shifts.
Bedtime (optional): warm turmeric milk (small cup, no sugar) or warm water.
SIMS / nutrition theory note: protein-first meals and steady timing support better appetite control and energy.
